svg.title: K5 acceptance by offered load
svg.desc: 39 core windows plus split diagnostic. Offered rates are categorical, not a fitted trend. Numeric scales are shared across workloads. Unavailable values appear in a separate strip. Each capture has exact source values in data attributes.
svg.text: 39 core windows plus split diagnostic; 400 forced output tokens per turn.
Horizontal offsets separate arms and repeats within each offered rate; points are categorical, not a fitted trend.

svg.text: Acceptance length = 1 + accepted-token deltas / draft-step deltas; the Y axis starts above zero.
NoSpec acceptance is unavailable. A/W2/0.02 acceptance is unavailable because native telemetry is inconclusive.
W1 and W2 have variable prompt lengths. The split diagnostic has unmatched cache state; maximum sustainable rates remain unestablished.
All numeric marks use the shared Y scale. Unavailable marks have no numeric value; horizontal position identifies offered rate and arm.
